summaries.summary: CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka withdrew from a Delhi High Court plea challenging their judicial custody.
Apple limits iPhone Duo orders to two per customer in an effort to prevent scalping as the product launches.
Anthropic proposes an AI safety policy that would restrict model releases if significant risk to human life is deemed possible.
Marco Rubio's visit to India's Reliance oil refinery aims to discuss imminent US-India trade deal and relationships with major Indian corporations.
Google is enhancing its Gemini AI assistant for vehicles, bringing more personalized assistance to drivers.
SpaceX reports better-than-expected performance from its AI business, contributing significantly to profitability.
Delhi's air quality worsens dramatically, prompting the initiation of GRAP-1 pollution restrictions across the National Capital Region.
Ambani's Jio IPO receives overwhelming investor interest, fully subscribed within 100 minutes, marking a record for Indian public offerings.
OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to strengthen its capabilities in biotechnology through its AI model for life sciences research.
Microsoft plans major changes to Xbox Game Pass, introducing customizable options for subscribers.
